Class DPoint

java.lang.Object
java.awt.geom.Point2D
java.awt.geom.Point2D.Double
jaba.DPoint
All Implemented Interfaces:

public class DPoint extends Point2D.Double
Point with double coordinates used by the JABA convex hull algorithms and graphs.
